name: What is the deposit/payment state of a reservation?
expected: 50% deposit dominates partially-paid reservations
detail: 306 live reservations · unpaid 124 · partial 139 · paid-in-full 39

name: What is the remaining balance?
expected: balance is derived as TOTL - PAID; POR stores no balance column
detail: Command Center must compute the balance, not expect a POR field

name: Which reservations have no deposit yet?
expected: reservations with no deposit are identifiable
actual: 124 of 306 live reservations carry no payment
detail: $625467.72 of reserved value is not secured by a deposit — a real chase signal Command Center does not surface today
note: POR side computable. No Command Center panel exposes this yet.

name: Service/fee SKUs excluded from rentable stock
expected: fee/service SKUs identifiable and excludable from rentable stock
detail: 171 of them carry a QTY that would inflate rentable counts if not excluded

name: Is this item available for this event date?
expected: availability nets future commitments for the requested date
detail: QYOT is out-TODAY only (394 items non-zero); date availability must net future reservations, which QTY-QYOT cannot do

name: What did this customer rent previously?
expected: prior rentals retrievable per customer
actual: 11186 customers with transactions; 6051 are repeat customers
detail: 36006 tickets across 11186 customers — history is meaningful and worth surfacing
